Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: DJ List cards now show each DJ's own name color/animated effect instead of one flat color, live DJs float to the front of the list, and there's a new name search box plus an Edit shortcut so you can jump straight into your own listing. Added a Top Live DJs spotlight above the grid - the top 3 by listener count orbit together with a fading comet trail. You can now drag to reposition your avatar, banner, or show image within the crop before saving instead of it always being auto-cropped dead center. Also fixed: avatar/banner uploading immediately instead of waiting for Save Listing (moved to the bottom-right of the form), and the DJ List/Live Shows grids silently clipping instead of scrolling - both also got a floating "back to top" button.
